is_anopheles.evidence: The paper focuses on Anopheles malaria vectors (e.g., Anopheles gambiae s.l., mentioning strains such as Kisumu and Tiassalé 13 on page 19, Table 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper discusses target site mutations (such as kdr) generally as part of strain characterisation recommendations, but does not genotype or report frequencies for any target markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data, counts, or frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito collections or tests on field-collected mosquitoes are reported; the paper presents consensus guidelines and illustrative bioassay data from laboratory colonies (Kisumu and Tiassalé 13).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a guidelines/consensus methodology paper developing a standard operating procedure for strain characterisation in ITN durability monitoring.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection sites are sampled or reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No mosquito collection dates or sampling windows are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: No primary empirical field dataset is reported.

supplement.evidence: The supplement contains an SOP (I2I-SOP-004) rather than empirical field genotype datasets.

assessment.summary: This article presents consensus guidelines and a standard operating procedure (SOP) for mosquito strain characterisation to measure the bioefficacy of dual-active ingredient ITNs during durability monitoring. It does not contain any primary empirical genotype data or field mosquito collections.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary empirical study (guidelines / protocol consensus)
No target insecticide resistance markers genotyped
No African field populations sampled or tested
